answer: A claimant records the depth and duration of the next voltage sag on its supply, and the smooth curve it submits must match the sag logged by the distribution operator for that feeder within tight tolerances. A marble floor cannot hide the difference: a sag that would wander in depth by chance still carries a recovery slope shaped by a zephyr gust, unique to that feeder, so identities sharing one sag signature beyond a small cluster are flagged as one location.
